title: Five New Lesson Cards a Day, From the Real Textbook | vitalii.no
description:
My kids' practice app could drill them with questions all day, but it never taught them anything first. There was no lesson content on the wall at all, so a child had to already know a topic before the quiz made sense, and the subjects had no connection to what they were actually studying in school that week.

I built a lesson pipeline that fetches source material for each child's actual subject, runs it through an AI fact-check pass, then writes five cards per subject as a daily ladder. The gate exposes token-protected lesson endpoints, and the kiosk now walks lesson cards first per child and subject, before falling back to drill scenes. The first real source: a child's own Natural Science textbook, chapter by chapter.

Each kid now wakes up to five new lesson cards a day, one ladder per subject, sourced from the actual textbook instead of a generic topic pool.
